attestation.risk_summary: This package is a sophisticated AI agent self-evolution framework with documented autonomous execution, programmatic npm install without audit flags, and a self-modification capability ('Mad Dog Mode') that represents genuinely elevated risk. The majority of SAST findings are false positives contextually appropriate to the tool's stated purpose, but two substantive concerns remain: the programmatic npm install with --no-audit in skills_monitor.js and an unverified split chain of custody between the 'openclaw' registry owner and the 'autogame-17' GitHub account that controls the update stream. No confirmed malicious payload, obfuscated code, or C2 indicators are present, but the architecture is weaponizable and the external trust anchor (autogame-17) has unverified provenance.
